# std/color

ANSI terminal color and style formatting.

```milo
from "std/color" import { Color }
```

## Example

```milo
print(Color.bold(Color.red("error:")) + " something went wrong")
print(Color.green("ok") + " " + Color.dim("(3 tests passed)"))
```
